## Hawaii Packing List for Blue Sparrow Tech Vacation

### Essentials
- Passport (valid for 6+ months beyond return date)
- Plane ticket
- Travel insurance documents
- Driver's license

### Clothing
- 3-4 tops/shirts
- 2-3 pairs shorts/pants
- 1-2 swimsuits
- 1-2 lightweight dresses
- 1 light jacket (evenings can be cool)
- Undergarments and socks
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals/flip flops
- Light sweater for cooler mornings/ evenings

### Beach and Water
- Reef-safe sunscreen
- Sunglasses
- Beach towel
- Water shoes
- Snorkeling gear (if applicable)
- Beach bag/backpack
- Water bottle
- Beach umbrella/ portable sun shelter

### Electronics
- Smartphone
- Portable charger
- Camera
- Waterproof phone case
- Universal power adapter
- Noise-cancelling headphones

### Personal Care
- Toiletry bag
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Prescription medications
- Contact lenses/glasses (if applicable)
- Travel-sized essentials

### Miscellaneous
- Reusable straw
- Collapsible cooler
- Beach reading material
- Travel-size games
- Portable power bank
- Snorkeling/ beach bag

### Blue Sparrow Tech Specific
- Business cards
- Company credit card
- Conference materials
- Laptop
- Portable charger
- Travel adapter

### Hawaii-Specific
- Mosquito repellent
- Rain jacket
- Light rain poncho
- Hawaii state park pass

### Notes
- Check weather forecast before departure
- Pack layers for varying temperatures
- Bring reef-safe sunscreen
- Leave valuables at home
- Consider packing a portable Wi-Fi hotspot
- Bring business attire for meetings

### Hawaii Packing Tips
- Pack light and versatile clothing
- Consider packing a small daypack for island-hopping
- Don't forget sunscreen and insect repellent
- Bring a portable charger for camera
- Hawaii has strict baggage restrictions, check airline requirements
- Consider packing a small portable power bank

### Vacation Dates
- Departure: [insert date]
- Return: [insert date]

### Company Policy
- All expenses must be submitted through company expense report
- Credit card receipts required for all purchases
- Receipts for all meals and activities
- Keep receipts organized in designated folder

### Contact Information
- Emma Johnson (primary contact)
- John Smith (secondary contact)
- Blue Sparrow Tech support (24/7)

### Emergency Contacts
- [insert emergency contact name]
- [insert emergency contact number]
- [insert emergency contact email]

### Flight Information
- Flight number: [insert flight number]
- Departure airport: [insert departure airport]
- Return airport: [insert return airport]

### Accommodations
- Hotel: [insert hotel name]
- Address: [insert hotel address]
- Check-in: [insert check-in date]
- Check-out: [insert check-out date]

### Itinerary
- Day 1: Arrival and check-in
- Day 2: Beach day
- Day 3: Island tour
- Day 4: Business meetings
- Day 5: Snorkeling
- Day 6: Departure

### Activities
- Snorkeling at Molokini Crater
- Island tour to Hana
- Visit to Haleakala National Park
- Business meetings at Blue Sparrow Tech HQ
- Luau dinner

### Dietary Restrictions
- Gluten-free
- Vegetarian
- Seafood

### Transportation
- Rental car: [insert rental car details]
- Airport shuttle: [insert airport shuttle details]

### Budget
- Daily allowance: $100
- Total budget: $500

### Notes
- Keep receipts organized
- Use company credit card for all expenses
- Submit expense report upon return
